plain_description.what: Across four anchor-free MMLU-Pro trees from different re-draws, it measures how often each branch point's cluster reappears in the other trees. It compares certified with uncertified branch points of the same depth and size, and also with random subsets. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: If the certificate means something, certified branch points should be more stable across re-draws than uncertified ones.
plain_description.information: Higher recurrence for certified sites would link the certificate to stability. Result: done, not shown, and the failure condition fired: certified branch points do not recur more than uncertified ones. Nearly all sites (263 of 264) recur more than random subsets, but that null is only a floor and shows just that the trees are related. Stability is not correctness either way.
